display.appliesTo: One enclosed room authored as metric Blender geometry with PBR, bake/probe, runtime GLB and an independently measured composition handoff. Separately routed exact component identities are removed before native authoring is saved or baked.
display.notFor: Multiple rooms, open environments, standalone objects, rigging, explicit 2D, or unknown room count. This pinned 0.3.1 adapter does not include the unreleased 0.4 house/schema-3 pipeline. Artifact production is not visual or gate acceptance.
